thresholds.positions: ||q_port - q_ref||_2 <= 10 (rel_tol ||q_ref||_2 + abs_tol) + 10 k u32 (||q_ref||_2 + dt ||v_ref||_2), k = number of earlier steps whose output the port stored in float32 (0 for single steps)
thresholds.iterations: |it_port - it_ref| <= 1 per step (Anderson roundoff can flip a gate)
thresholds.multipliers: |lambda_port - lambda_ref| <= 5e-6 |lambda_ref| + 1e-6 max|lambda_ref| + 1e-12 (reference trace prints 6 significant digits)
thresholds.gradients_exact: ||g_port - g_ref||_2 <= 1e-5 ||g_ref||_2 on free particles (dL/dq, dL/dv, each step's dL/df_ext, dL/du); no contact, homogeneous or grouped materials
thresholds.gradients_contact: ||g_port - g_ref||_2 <= 1e-4 ||g_ref||_2 (contact Woodbury: capped W_T fixed points)
thresholds.materials: per reference energy: |g_port - g_ref| <= tol |g_ref| + steps u32 sum_e |g_port,e| (port returns float32 per-element values); tol as for the regime
thresholds.mesh_contact: reference mesh_contact state force (zero backward on both sides): judged by the position, velocity, iteration and exact-regime gradient thresholds above; per-step forces and pair counts are reported
thresholds.heterogeneous_per_element: gradients reported, not judged: documented deviation (port K uses element weights, reference K the mean weight of each energy)

performance.scene: BearProblem (276 nodes, 768 tets, planar frictional boundary, friction 0.7, 8 muscle groups)
performance.timing: synchronized wall time per step; port: wp.synchronize_device before and after step; reference: PyForward/PyBackward are synchronous (device-to-host copies), including SWIG list conversion
performance.backward_window: taped rollout of 30 steps, second repetition, steps >= 10

gpu_path.used_for: A^{-1} applications (two cuSPARSE SpMV per axis) and batched Delassus SpMM; local step, contact Newton, Anderson and the whole backward pass (CPU LDLT, by design) run on the CPU
